picks.title: Fortnite creators won't be able to escape AI come the end of July
picks.excerpt: From July 30, UEFN creators will be able to place AI-powered characters on their Fortnite islands, pushing conversational NPCs into mainstream UGC creation.
picks.rationale: A dated, concrete platform change — from July 30 UEFN creators can drop conversational AI NPCs into islands, rewriting how UGC designers script characters next week.

picks.title: MetaHumans in Blender: Using OpenRigLogic to Customize DNA's Behavior | Inside Unreal
picks.excerpt: Following Epic's MetaHuman Devkit announcement at Unreal Fest, Poly Hammer shows OpenRigLogic running inside Blender to customise MetaHuman DNA behaviour outside Unreal.
picks.rationale: First-party Epic session showing MetaHuman rig logic running outside Unreal — a directly reusable character pipeline for Blender-based artists.

picks.title: Take cover, because it looks like more than half of Steam games will have an AI-disclosure by 2027-2028
picks.excerpt: A full census of 53,597 Steam releases finds 30.8% of 2026 games carry an AI disclosure, with the curve pointing at a majority by 2027-2028. Most of that growth comes from games that barely earn anything.
picks.rationale: A full 53,597-title census rather than a vibe check — it gives teams a hard baseline for where AI disclosure sits on the storefront and where the curve is heading.

picks.title: Mario Kart Wii is being "rebuilt for PC," but the project's AI vibe coding instantly soured many Nintendo fans on the project
picks.excerpt: "The first static recompilation of a Wii game" was largely produced with AI coding agents, and the disclosure immediately split the modding community.
picks.rationale: Freshest item in the pool and a genuine technical first — AI coding agents completing a static recompilation, plus the community credibility cost of disclosing it.

picks.title: Text to speech history: save, replay, and reload every AI voice take (Inworld Text-to-Speech)
picks.excerpt: Inworld's TTS Playground now keeps a full history of every generated voice take, with voice, model and settings preserved — a version-control layer for AI game dialogue.
picks.rationale: Small feature, real workflow fix: persistent take history with voice/model/settings gives AI game dialogue the versioning audio designers have been missing.
